links.comparator_used: Unreviewed system-generated (DUMS) outputs, and ChatGPT-4 outputs, rated by senior health care professionals on a 5-point Likert scale
links.outcome: Expert-rated medication schedule and self-management program quality (accuracy, safety, comprehensiveness, richness)
links.effect: Pharmacist-refined outputs (intervention group) scored higher than DUMS and GPT-4 groups on all indicator scores; no numeric values reported in the abstract
links.quote: The intervention group outperformed the DUMS and GPT-4 groups on all indicator scores.

design_hint: pharmacist review and refinement of system outputs
